title: the main task's name and result have no mark hook, so the string is swept and its slot reused
live_proof: upstream fixed it in 628ccec60 (628ccec600e09a6671765b2800058c358974a740) (2026-08-23), which is in master and postdates the 4.0.0-rc2 pin (2026-03-12); the pin's tree has no such fix. Host ASan at the pin: no report (with MRB_HEAP_PAGE_SIZE=1: heap-use-after-free); the same case on master: no report
fidelity: the trigger is the Ruby test upstream added with its fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
